subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: If this selected `openai-completions` proxy still fails after the existing sanitizers, should OpenClaw wait for the captured failing payload, improve diagnostics only, or add a strict-minimal/provider feature-disable mode?
rationale: The report asks for both compatibility behavior and diagnostics, but current evidence does not identify a single bad generated field; adding strict-minimal mode or feature controls would create new provider/config policy.

options.title: Require Payload Capture First
options.body: Keep this open as needs-info and implement only a targeted sanitizer or diagnostic once a redacted OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body shows the incompatible feature.

options.title: Add Strict-Minimal Mode
options.body: Define an explicit provider/model compatibility mode that emits a reduced chat-completions payload for narrower proxies, with docs and upgrade-safe config handling.

options.title: Diagnostics-Only
options.body: Improve fallback logging or diagnostic export around provider request/response summaries without adding a new compatibility mode yet.

recommendation.title: Require Payload Capture First
recommendation.body: Keep this open as needs-info and implement only a targeted sanitizer or diagnostic once a redacted OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body shows the incompatible feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to osolmaz for provider fallback follow-up.
